title: get api v1 public projects slug not found
description: Verify that GET /api/v1/public/projects/:slug with a nonexistent slug returns a 404 status with a handled not-found response.

title: post api v1 auth login valid credentials
description: Verify that POST /api/v1/auth/login with valid credentials returns 200 with Access Token and Refresh Token.

title: post api v1 auth login invalid credentials
description: Verify that POST /api/v1/auth/login with invalid credentials returns 401 with a generic authentication error and no user-existence disclosure.

title: post api v1 auth refresh valid token
description: Verify that POST /api/v1/auth/refresh with a valid Refresh Token returns 200 with a new Access Token.

title: post api v1 auth refresh expired or malformed token
description: Verify that POST /api/v1/auth/refresh with expired or malformed token returns 401 with an authentication error response.

title: post api v1 auth logout valid refresh token
description: Verify that POST /api/v1/auth/logout with a valid Refresh Token returns 204 or 200 confirming logout and invalidates the token for further refresh attempts.

title: post api v1 admin posts create duplicate slug
description: Verify that POST /api/v1/admin/posts with a duplicate slug returns 409 conflict or validation error indicating the slug is already in use.

title: post api v1 contact valid submission
description: Verify that POST /api/v1/contact with valid name, email, message, and captcha token returns 201 or 200 confirming submission, persists the message, and sends notification email.

title: post api v1 contact missing or invalid captcha
description: Verify that POST /api/v1/contact with missing or invalid captcha token returns 400 or 403 with captcha validation failure.

title: get api v1 health check
description: Verify that GET /api/v1/health returns 200 with healthy status and service metadata.

title: get api v1 admin posts id versions valid
description: Verify that GET /api/v1/admin/posts/:id/versions with valid Bearer token returns 200 with list of version summaries matching PostVersionSummary and pagination metadata.

title: get api v1 admin posts id versions unauthorized
description: Verify that GET /api/v1/admin/posts/:id/versions without Bearer token returns 401 Unauthorized.

title: get security headers and content security policy
description: Verify that HTTP responses include X-Frame-Options: DENY, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, Strict-Transport-Security, and strict Content-Security-Policy header.

title: post api v1 auth refresh revoked token reuse detection
description: Verify that reusing a previously rotated or revoked refresh token fails with 401 and revokes the session family (T06.04).

title: get api cron maintenance unauthorized
description: Verify that GET /api/cron/maintenance without valid CRON_SECRET authorization header returns 401 Unauthorized.

title: get api cron maintenance authorized
description: Verify that GET /api/cron/maintenance with valid Bearer CRON_SECRET returns 200 confirming successful purge execution and audit timestamp.

title: resend email deliverability dns validation
description: Verify that domain email records (SPF, DKIM, DMARC, MX) pass deliverability checks.

title: get como foi construído page pt and en
description: Verify that GET /pt-BR/como-foi-construido and GET /en/como-foi-construido return 200 OK with authentic editorial content, ADRs, metrics, and zero exposed secrets.

title: get api docs interactive documentation
description: Verify that GET /api/docs returns 200 OK with Swagger UI and OpenAPI documentation links.
